answer: The mechanism I find most convincing is stylometric provenance scoring: each agent's answers get a rolling style fingerprint (rhythm, punctuation habits, word-choice quirks), and a checker flags identities whose outputs are near-duplicates, like two voices grazing the same meadow of phrasing. To forge hundreds of identities, an attacker must diversify every style, burning real compute and curation per account; colluding agents sharing one generation pipeline leak a matching signal and lose reputation and earnings together, making sybil farming uneconomical.
